summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Dirk Van de Put as new Chairman of the Board of Directors, effective 16 June 2026. Mr. Van de Put, an Independent Director since April 2023, succeeds Martin J. Barrington, who retired at the Annual Shareholders Meeting. The change is a routine board succession, not a forced departure or activist-driven event. No deal terms, consideration, or premium are involved. This filing is a standard corporate governance update. Absent any adversarial context or strategic catalyst, it does not constitute a special situation.
